title: Florida House, District 40
what_it_does: Represents District 40 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: On the Nov. 3 ballot. The Florida Division of Elections 2026 general-election candidate list (checked Oct. 7, 2026) shows 2 qualified candidates: Tuan Le (Republican), Ra'Shon Young (Democrat). An earlier version of this guide marked the seat as decided, based on a report published before candidate qualifying closed on June 12; that was wrong. Source: https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp

candidates.name: Ra'Shon Young
candidates.occupation: Entrepreneur; former chief of staff to state Rep. LaVon Bracy Davis
candidates.background: RaShon Young, born in 1999, is a Bethune-Cookman University graduate who started several businesses, worked in government auditing for the city of Titusville and spent three years as chief of staff to state Rep. LaVon Bracy Davis. He won a September 2, 2025 special election for District 40 and serves on the State Affairs Committee. He has chaired the political action committee of the Orange County NAACP.

taxes.summary: No public position found as of Sept 2026.

property_tax.summary: Voted against CS/HJR 1-F (2026), the June 2026 joint resolution that placed Amendment 3 on the ballot to raise the non-school homestead exemption to $250,000 by 2028 and let counties and cities exempt homesteads entirely; because the vote sent the question to voters rather than cutting taxes itself, a vote for it is coded as leaning toward sharply reducing homestead property taxes rather than as full agreement.

insurance.summary: His campaign site calls for insurance reform that stabilizes the market, increases transparency, holds companies accountable and ensures claims are paid fairly; it does not mention rate caps or Citizens.
insurance.quote: That includes stabilizing the insurance market, increasing transparency, holding companies accountable, and ensuring that claims are handled fairly and efficiently.

sources.title: RaShon Young for House District 40: Fixing Florida's Property Insurance Crisis

housing.summary: He says he will fight to cap rent increases and expand affordable housing, and his campaign site calls for more affordable housing supply, protections for renters and holding large investors accountable.
housing.quote: I will fight to cap predatory rent increases, expand affordable housing, advocate for paid family leave, and work to raise the minimum wage.

candidates.name: Tuan Le
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Engineer and business owner (aerospace, water and wastewater, IT and cybersecurity; real estate, hospitality and technology)
candidates.background: Le says he was raised in Pine Hills and attended Carver Middle School and Evans High School before earning an engineering degree at the University of Central Florida and an MBA at Strayer University. He describes himself as an aerospace engineer, a water and wastewater engineer, an IT and cybersecurity analyst, and an entrepreneur in real estate, hospitality and technology. He says his first job, at 14, was picking up trash and repairing salvaged electronics to help support his family, and in an earlier survey he described himself as a Vietnamese American whose family came to the United States legally.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

housing.summary: In his 2025 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Le proposed a 'Zoning Equity Act' that would let owners of property more than 50 years old obtain rezoning within the same use category so they could build on the property, add accessory units, rent it out or sell unused portions. He said the change would lower rents and help property owners. In an earlier 2022 survey he listed affordable housing among his priorities.
housing.quote: This will help residential low the rent cost and homeowner put money in their pockets.

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey - Tuan Le (2025)
Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey - Tuan Le (2022, congressional campaign)

taxes.summary: Le proposed a 'Small Business Tax Credit Act' as one of his three key campaign messages, offering tax incentives to small businesses that hire locally and train young people. He did not say in the survey what spending would change.
taxes.quote: This act will offer real tax incentives to small businesses that hire locally, train young people, and help rebuild the local economy.

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey - Tuan Le (2025)

immigration.summary: In his 2022 Ballotpedia survey, filed as a candidate for Congress, Le listed stopping illegal immigration at the border among his three key messages and said his own family immigrated legally from Vietnam. He did not address deportation of people already in the country.
immigration.quote: We must stop illegal immigration that endlessly drains our resources.

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey - Tuan Le (2022, congressional campaign)

other_issues.title: Career and technical training
other_issues.summary: Le proposed an 'Education Act' that would use high school campuses as technical training centers after 6 p.m., offering adults and young people training in trades such as plumbing, electrical, HVAC, coding, artificial intelligence, robotics and health care, along with an after-school innovation and technology program for children.

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey - Tuan Le (2025)
